adaptation: Solid has a render callback instead of React element cloning, native ref callbacks/arrays instead of React ref objects, and class instead of className. Element-render source branches map many-to-one to native callback composition when all observable assertions are retained. Random data strings become deterministic source-value/custom strings; no assertion relies on randomness. React immediate post-render flush calls are not imported into the already awaited native render factory.
